scenarios.name: Feint against the humanoids
scenarios.description: A single squad of Rasczak's Roughnecks hits a Skinny colony. Introductory scenario that removes ranged combat entirely - focuses on drop and retrieval.
special_rules: Ranged combat is removed - only close combat
Focuses on drop and retrieval mechanics

victory_conditions.terran_victory: Eliminate all Humanoid units or extract with sufficient victory points

scenarios.name: Operation Bughouse
scenarios.description: A complete platoon takes on an Arachnid hive. First full scenario with all mechanics.
special_rules: Full combat rules apply
Arachnid player sets up hidden tunnel system

victory_conditions.terran_victory: Capture the Brain Bug or eliminate sufficient Bug forces
victory_conditions.arachnid_victory: Eliminate all Terran units or survive all turns

scenarios.name: Invasion of Skinny-5
scenarios.description: A platoon's attack on a Skinny industrial center. Humanoids defend critical installations.
special_rules: Humanoid critical installations must be captured
Power, communications, and water facilities are objectives

victory_conditions.arachnid_victory: Defend installations or eliminate Terran forces

scenarios.name: Revolt!
scenarios.description: The Skinnies change sides and attack the Arachnids with the help of the Mobile Infantry. First scenario with combined Terran-Humanoid forces.
special_rules: Terran and Humanoid units move together during the same player segment
Terran and Humanoid units may not voluntarily stack together
Terran and Humanoid units may not combine attack strengths
They may not attack the same enemy unit in the same combat phase
Humanoid units use Terran attack table when attacking Arachnids

victory_conditions.terran_victory: Capture the Brain Bug with combined forces

scenarios.name: Sheol - Part 1: Operation Corkscrew
scenarios.description: The combat engineers enter the battle. Focus on tunnel breaching and underground combat.
special_rules: Combat engineers can breach tunnels
MI can enter tunnel systems
Sensors can detect tunnel locations

victory_conditions.arachnid_victory: Defend the complex and eliminate attackers

scenarios.name: Sheol - Part 2: Retreat and Evacuation
scenarios.description: A group of wounded M.I. are rescued. Evacuation scenario with retrieval boats.
special_rules: Wounded units must be evacuated
Retrieval boats are available
Time pressure - must extract before time runs out

victory_conditions.arachnid_victory: Prevent evacuation or eliminate all Terran units

scenarios.name: Operation Royalty
scenarios.description: A reinforced platoon takes on two Arachnid complexes to capture a Brain Bug. Large scenario with multiple objectives.
special_rules: Two Arachnid complexes
Brain Bug is the primary objective
Reinforced platoon strength

victory_conditions.arachnid_victory: Protect the Brain Bug or eliminate all Terran forces

scenarios.name: Klendathu
scenarios.description: Two platoons vs. two Arachnid complexes in a fight to free human prisoners of war. The ultimate battle - largest scenario.
special_rules: Two full platoons
Two Arachnid complexes
Human POWs must be rescued
Full rules including nuclear weapons

victory_conditions.terran_victory: Rescue human POWs and destroy both complexes
victory_conditions.arachnid_victory: Defend both complexes and eliminate all Terran forces

victory_point_system.description: Victory is determined by counting victory points for eliminated units and objectives
victory_point_system.notes: Units that are KIA, WIA, or disrupted do not count for victory point purposes
